units.source_text: 苗子虽然说了三遍“再见”，可是千重子踌躇了半天：

en.t: Although Naeko had said goodbye three times, Chieko hesitated for a long while:

units.source_text: 是在这儿和她分手，还是经过丸太铺前或走到那附近，

en.t: should she part from her here, or pass in front of the Maruta shop, or go somewhere nearby,

units.source_text: 告诉她是哪一家以后再别离呢？

en.t: and tell her which house it was before saying goodbye?

units.source_text: 她对苗子好像已经生出了一股温暖而亲切的感情。

en.t: She seemed already to have developed a warm and affectionate feeling toward Naeko.
